job.question: In the CAJPA sample investment management RFP (Appendix Z, 'Sample Investment Management Request for Proposal'), how many copies of the proposal must be sent?
job.expected_facts: Ten (10) copies of the proposal and correspondence, sent to the pool administrator (shown as 'John Doe, 123 Main Street' in the template).
job.acceptance: Ten/10 copies suffices; template addressee and correspondence wording are optional.

reviews.reason: The supplied document is CCCERA’s April 2018 master custodian RFP, not CAJPA’s Appendix Z sample investment management RFP. Its proposal-copy requirement cannot establish the requirement in the question.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR MASTER CUSTODIAN AND RELATED SERVICES April 2018 Contra Costa County Employees’ Retirement Association
The Proposer shall submit one (1) original proposal, four (4) hard copies of the proposal, and one (1) copy in electronic form.
